title: An ample invertible module has a finite affine principal-open cover
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] with an ample invertible $\mathcal L$ [def-sc-invertible-module] [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module]. Then there are finitely many integers $n_i>0$ and sections $s_i\in\Gamma(X,\mathcal L^{\otimes n_i})$ such that every $X_{s_i}$ is affine and $X=\bigcup_iX_{s_i}$.

source.place: Properties Definition 01PS and Proposition 01Q3, implication (1) => (2), first paragraph of Lemma 01Q1 proof

proof.text: For each point $x\in X$, clause (2) of [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module] gives an integer $n_x>0$ and a section $s_x\in\Gamma(X,\mathcal L^{\otimes n_x})$ such that $x\in X_{s_x}$ and $X_{s_x}$ is affine. The same definition states that each nonvanishing locus $X_s$ is open, so the family $\{X_{s_x}\}_{x\in X}$ is an open cover of $X$.

source.place: Properties Lemma 09NV and Definition 01PS, the pointwise affine principal-open condition

proof.text: By the ampleness hypothesis, $X$ is quasi-compact: this is clause (1) of [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module]. By the definition of quasi-compactness [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme], the open cover from the preceding step has a finite subcover $X_{s_1},\ldots,X_{s_m}$. Writing $n_i$ and $s_i$ for the corresponding powers and sections gives $n_i>0$, each $X_{s_i}$ affine, and $X=\bigcup_iX_{s_i}$.

source.place: Section 01K2, definition of quasi-compactness, applied to the open cover of Section 01PR/Definition 01PS

lean.statement: theorem IsAmple.exists_finite_affine_cover (X : Scheme.{u}) (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible] (hL : IsAmple X L) : ∃ (m : ℕ) (n : Fin m → ℕ) (s : (i : Fin m) → (L.tensorPow (n i)).val.presheaf.obj (Opposite.op ⊤)) (U : Fin m → X.Opens), (∀ i : Fin m, 0 < n i) ∧ (∀ i : Fin m, IsAffineOpen (U i)) ∧ (∀ (i : Fin m) (x : X), x ∈ U i ↔ (TopCat.Presheaf.germ (L.tensorPow (n i)).val.presheaf ⊤ x trivial) (s i) ∉ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x)) • (⊤ : Submodule (X.presheaf.stalk x) ↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (L.tensorPow (n i)).val.presheaf x))) ∧ (∀ x : X, ∃ i : Fin m, x ∈ U i)
